Title: GraphQL request url is https://<storefront host>/graphql (no missing slash, no operation name in the path)
Section: Observability > Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry > Request url
Preconditions: Non-prod env whose backend runs the OpenTelemetry-based VirtoCommerce.ApplicationInsights module (VCST-4717; exported sdkVersion contains "otel") with APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING set, a storefront reachable at {{FRONT_URL}} and the platform at {{BACK_URL}}. App Insights READ access for the backend resource (AAD via Connect-AzAccount, or APPINSIGHTS_API_KEY_BACKEND); query helper ci/lib/appinsights.ts queryAppInsights("backend", kql, timespan). Without read access every telemetry assertion is UNVERIFIABLE, not failing.
Test_Data: OP_NAME = "AgentTestObs" + 6 random alphanumerics from scripts/lib/random-data.ts, generated once per run (never a literal, so a row from another run or the env's own traffic cannot satisfy the case). GraphQL endpoint {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql; store {{STORE_ID}} (or @td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)). Window is always relative (ago(30m)); ingestion lag is 2-5 min, so poll the KQL every 30 s for up to 10 min before concluding a row is absent.
Steps:
[HTTP] Fire >=14 times, paced ~0.7 s apart (repetition defeats sampling; state how many you fired): POST {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql, body {"operationName":"<OP_NAME>","query":"query <OP_NAME> { store(storeId:\"{{STORE_ID}}\") { storeId } }"}, anonymous. Expect HTTP 200 and no errors[].
[WAIT] Poll the KQL below every 30 s, up to 10 min, until n >= 1 (the summarize always returns one row, so the row count says nothing).
[KQL] requests | where timestamp > ago(30m) | where name == "POST graphql/<OP_NAME>" | extend u=parse_url(url) | summarize n=count(), badShape=countif(not(url matches regex @"^https://[^/]+/graphql$")), hosts=make_set(tostring(u.Host)), anyUrl=take_any(url).
Cross_Layer_Checks: Confirm the data lands in the BACKEND App Insights resource, not the storefront one; where an old-build resource exists, compare the same KQL over the same hours.
Failure_Signals: url = http://<host>graphql/<OP_NAME> (slash lost, operation name appended to the path); url ends in /graphql/<OP_NAME>; more than one host; zero rows (named operation not recorded - see OBS-003).
Cleanup: None (read-only). The synthetic operation name starts with AgentTestObs (a GraphQL name cannot carry the AGENT-TEST- hyphen); exclude agent traffic from monitoring on that prefix.
References: VCST-4717 (round-1 Bug 2). Catches:VCST-4717 Archetype:PARITY Technique:EG Purpose:FUNC. Checklist row 4. Catches: the OpenTelemetry HTTP-server url being rebuilt from Host + Path without a separator and with the GraphQL operation name as the path. Observed fixed on vcptcore_qa1 2026-11-11 (module 3.1006.0-pr-17). DV-002-OK (https:// here is a KQL string-shape pattern, not an origin). | Promoted: VCST-4717 (2026-11-11)

Every returned name has the form "POST graphql/<OperationName>" with a non-empty OperationName — no "POST /graphql", "POST graphql", "POST graphql/" or other name for the unnamed calls. {OBSERVED}

Failure_Signals: Unnamed calls recorded under "POST /graphql" (the AddIgnoreRequestTelemetry("/graphql", exceptWhenTag: "graphql.type") rule stopped applying); control missing too (nothing ingested - UNVERIFIABLE, not PASS).
